'''Shura''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served in the [[Mantellian Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as an [[Quartermaster/Legends|Ordnance officer]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the war she was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where the [[Ord Mantell Central Authority]] was at [[Separatist War|war]] with a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]]. There, she operated a stall in [[Oradam village]] from which she sold various weapons. While at her stall she wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] including a helmet, and white [[Clothing/Legends|leggings]]. Shura had fair skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shura first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]]. In the game she acts as a Republic weapons vendor on Ord Mantell. Her location is also marked on a map in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]''.
